verdict.rationale: GitHub Projects documents native, two-way integration with GitHub issues and pull requests: changes made in the project show up on the issue, and custom fields attach to issues and PRs. That covers the GitHub part of the story. There is no evidence of native Slack or Google Drive connectors, and the GraphQL API and Actions are developer building blocks that earn no credit here. missing for 10: native Slack integration, native Google Drive integration, a broader integrations catalog, independent corroboration

support.subject: As an engineer, I can connect common tools like Slack, GitHub, and Google Drive natively

citations.quote: For example, change an assignee in your project and that change is shown in your issue.
You can use custom fields to add metadata to your issues, pull requests, and draft issues and build a richer view of item attributes.
